events.verdict: Sabonis (SAC) turns to roll and the contact with LaRavia (LAL) is incidental.
LaRavia (LAL) legally contests the jump shot attempt by Schroder (SAC), who extends his leg to attempt to create contact. There is no contact initiated by LaRavia on the play.
Schroder (SAC) cleanly blocks LaRavia's (LAL) shot attempt near the rim.
Vanderbilt (LAL) directly contests LaVine's (SAC) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to LaVine's (SAC) hand after the release.
DeRozan (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during Reaves' (LAL) drive to the basket.
Reaves (LAL) begins to lose his balance near midcourt and any contact by Sabonis (SAC) and Ellis (SAC) is marginal.
Reaves (LAL) maintains his position in the frontcourt before the release of the pass.
LaVine (SAC) obtains a legal guarding position along the baseline and absorbs the contact with Hachimura (LAL) during his driving shot attempt.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that Hachimura's (LAL) shot attempt makes contact with the rim and therefore, the shot clock is reset to 14 and LAL retains possession.
Schroder (SAC) briefly grabs Reaves' (LAL) arm and the contact is marginal as Reaves attempts to disengage.
Ellis (SAC) steps into Reaves' (LAL) path and initiates body contact that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
LaVine (SAC) commits a take foul on Reaves (LAL).
LaVine (SAC) places his off-arm against Smart (LAL), but releases away without applying force as he loses control of his dribble.
LaVine (SAC) loses control of the ball into the backcourt and it is never touched by Smart (LAL). LaVine then illegally recovers possession in the backcourt.
LaVine (SAC) fumbles the ball and legally bats it in order to retain possession.
Reaves (LAL) wraps his arm around Sabonis (SAC), causing him to lose his balance.
Westbrook (SAC) commits a take foul on Ayton (LAL).
Vanderbilt (LAL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
